page.metaDescription: A Kompyte alternative with prices on the page. Track competitor websites, pricing and hiring and get a weekly AI brief. Monthly plans from $29, paid by card.
page.h1: A Kompyte alternative with published pricing
page.subtitle: Kompyte, now part of Semrush, automates competitive intelligence for sales and marketing teams on annual plans. WebMonitor is a smaller, self-serve option for teams who mainly need to know what competitors changed.
page.intro: Kompyte tracks competitor websites, content, ads, reviews and job postings, filters the results with AI and turns them into daily summaries, battlecards and win-loss reports. Its plans are sized for teams, starting at 10 competitors and 25 users, and are sold annually after a platform tour, without published prices. WebMonitor focuses on competitor websites, publishes its prices and bills monthly by card.

features.title: Prices you can see
features.body: Starter is $29/mo for 25 pages checked every 6 hours, Growth is $79/mo for 100 pages checked hourly, and Agency is $149/mo for 250 pages.

features.title: Watchlists per market
features.body: Group competitors into a watchlist and WebMonitor finds their pricing, changelog, blog and careers pages automatically.

features.title: A weekly read, not a daily feed
features.body: One brief every Monday across all competitors in the watchlist, by email and Slack, with instant alerts only for the rules you set.

features.title: Built for a team of one
features.body: No seats to buy and no onboarding call. A founder or product marketer can set it up in an afternoon.

page.useCasesTitle: WebMonitor is the better fit if you
useCases: Want to see the price before talking to sales
Do not need ad, social or review tracking
Prefer monthly billing by card to an annual contract paid by invoice
page.limitsTitle: When Kompyte is the better choice
page.limits: Choose Kompyte if you need ad, social and review tracking alongside websites, battlecards and win-loss reports for a sales team, CRM and sales tool integrations, or if you already use Semrush. WebMonitor watches public web pages only and does not make battlecards.

faq.a: Kompyte does not publish prices on its plans page. Its tiers are Essentials (10 companies, 25 users), Professional (20 companies, 100 users) and Unlimited, sold annually. WebMonitor publishes its prices: $29, $79 or $149 a month.

faq.q: Does WebMonitor track competitor ads and social posts?
faq.a: No. WebMonitor watches public web pages such as pricing, changelogs, blogs and careers. Ads and social posts are not covered.

faq.q: Does WebMonitor track competitor job postings?
faq.a: Yes, through the competitor's careers page. The weekly brief notes new roles and what they suggest, such as a first sales hire in a new region.
